text:
zoe: VoltChip asked for a marketplace-ready perf/W stat but also wants a clear thermal/cooling disclaimer. Can we agree on wording + artifacts needed?

matt: Short checklist: raw CSVs, kernel commit hash, config.yaml, PDU wiring note, 16:9 hero image, and mean/std over 3 runs. Tile only shows conservative verified number; blog can expand.

ivan: From infra: please standardize the watt measurement: sum both PDU legs, sample at 1s, average over 300s steady window starting after 180s warmup. We'll include a pdu_scraper script in artifacts.

voltchip-eng: We'll provide rack cooling spec and confirm PDUs report wall watts. Also request the tile include a single-sentence note: "Measured at VoltChip Rack A under specified cooling config." Does that work?

zoe: Yes. Marketing wants a short templated disclaimer: "Results measured on partner hardware under the test conditions in the artifact bundle. Actual results may vary with cooling and workload." Keep it short.

matt: Proposed acceptance thresholds for the tile (must be met across 3 runs):
- mean tokens/s >= 10,200 per rack
- mean perf/W >= 12 tokens/s/W
- p99 <= 300ms @512
If any metric misses but kernel shows consistent uplift, blog can mention upcoming kernel; tile stays strict.

ivan: I'll post a reproducible smoke command and the pdu_scraper snippet in the artifacts folder. Example command:
```
bench_tool --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --warmup=180 --steady=300 --runs=3 --collect=tokens_s,p99,pdu_watts --kernel=lprefetch-v1 --out=artifacts/voltchip-3run.csv
```

voltchip-eng: We'll slot an engineer for the Wed 9am PT cross-org test and upload rack spec + hero image by Tue EOD. Also will provide the exact PDU IDs.

ops-bot: Created ticket LEGAL-1203 for co-announcement review. ETA 48h. Calendar invite sent for Wed 9am PT cross-org call.

zoe: Action items:
- ivan: pdu_scraper + bench command + run 3 sweeps and paste CSVs (due: Tue 4pm PT)
- voltchip-eng: rack spec + hero image + PDU IDs (due: Tue EOD)
- matt: draft tile copy + short disclaimer and hold until legal signoff (due: Wed AM)
- ops-bot: legal ticket + invite (done)

matt: Also add a short reproducibility subsection in artifacts called "how_we_tested.md" with KV-cache warmup steps and cooling setpoint. That prevents ambiguity for customers replicating runs.

zoe: Sounds good. If anything slips, flag here and we'll triage. We'll keep tile conservative and put technical detail in the public artifact bundle. :white_check_mark:
